strategy.overview: Pinball Champ makes the upper playfield its most valuable controlled visit. Hit the white fixed targets and blue drop targets to add upper-playfield time; completing the white set flashes the tunnel multiplier, while blue-bank completions raise the booster and advance Orange Special. On the upper level, each C-H-A-M-P target scores strongly and completing the word advances Red Special. Hard spinner shots raise the lane value.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit the white fixed targets and blue drop targets to add upper-playfield time. Complete the white set to flash the tunnel multiplier, and complete blue banks to raise the booster and advance Orange Special. On the upper level, spell C-H-A-M-P to advance Red Special. Shoot the spinner hard to raise the lane value.
strategy.summary: Build upper-playfield time before entering it, then stay there long enough to finish C-H-A-M-P. Use white targets for the tunnel multiplier and blue drops for booster and Orange Special progress.

quickInfo.name: Add Upper Time
quickInfo.summary: Hit white fixed targets and blue drops.

quickInfo.name: Build Red Special
quickInfo.summary: Spell C-H-A-M-P on the upper level.

steps.text: Hit white fixed targets and blue drop targets to add time for the next upper-playfield visit.
Complete all white targets to flash the tunnel multiplier, then make the tunnel while it is valuable.
On the upper playfield, hit C-H-A-M-P and complete the word to advance Red Special.
Complete blue drop banks to raise the booster and advance Orange Special; use hard spinner shots to raise the lane value.

alternatives.title: Build the booster first
alternatives.when: Use this when the upper entrance is not ready or upper time is low.

steps.text: Finish a blue drop bank for more upper time and booster progress.
Enter the upper level only after enough time is banked to work C-H-A-M-P.
Build time and prepare the white or blue set before sending the ball upstairs.
Finish C-H-A-M-P and take the best lit tunnel or Special collect on the way out.

machineSetup: Check upper-playfield time, Red and Orange Special thresholds, tunnel multiplier, booster, and Special awards.
Test white fixed targets, blue drops, upper entrance and timer, C-H-A-M-P targets, tunnel, booster, spinner, and lane-value lamps.

cautions.response: Add time before entering instead of spending the visit on an incomplete C-H-A-M-P set.
